# Operator Guide (`docs/handover/operator-guide.md`)

**Current cut — [follow-up 21](follow-up-21.md) (2026-10-31 EDT):** Through #351: positive-cache limits, retained verified install archives and Dependabot #22 status are documented. Regular AT23–AT27 and assembled D-087 AT10 pass; historical failures remain frozen.
Previous cut: [follow-up 20](follow-up-20.md), through #344.

## Operator changes at #351

**Positive DNS cache:** AdGuard v0.107.59 can replace a newer cached answer
with an older outstanding upstream reply that completes after client
abandonment but before its 10 s upstream timeout (F9-INFLIGHT, #345).
TTL is a maximum lifetime, not a minimum retention or cross-query consistency
promise. Independent resolver caches and whole-second expiry also matter.
No exposed setting orders these replies by authority version. When choosing
production `blocked_response_ttl`, retain this limitation; the value remains
the owner's decision. A cache setting is not a fix for this ordering behavior.
[Attribution and measured defaults](../dns/BACKEND.md#215-f10-03--positive-cache-and-ttl-measured-2026-10-31).

**Offline seed:** initial and same-release installs retain the verified archive
and envelope (#351's corrected guide). Seed verifies a private copy and the
whole installed tree without fetching the artifact while that archive exists.
Only an absent archive chooses the guarded signed-URL download. A corrupt or
unreadable archive fails closed; restore the signed package and rerun the
same-release installer. This is seed's offline capability, not offline
enrollment. [Installer hand-off](../updates/node-updater.md#installer-hand-off-d-080-d-089-d-110).

**Dependabot #22:** remains open for owner disposition (#349). All minimatch
paths are development tooling; no production-bundle path was found.
`npm audit fix` changes nothing, and the complete 11.0.3 override breaks
jsx-a11y's nested-label rule after clean `npm ci`. Both dependency files stay
byte-identical. Do not apply that override or dismiss the alert as a repair.
This is a dependency-hygiene item, not a product defect.
[Portal investigation](../portal/DEV.md#development-dependency-advisory--2026-10-31-follow-up-19).

## Reporting and restart changes at #344

Installer 7 requires `--control-url` as a validated HTTPS origin and a readable
`--server-ca`. It generates `result_url` at
`POST /api/v1/agent/update-results`, server trust from that enrollment CA, and
the enrolled node's mTLS certificate/key paths. `allowed_artifact_origins` is
exactly the control origin. Invalid inputs fail before host changes. A
same-release rerun repairs reporting fields/server CA and preserves identity,
usage, updater journal and unrelated settings. `install --allow-loopback` is
an explicit **TEST ONLY** opt-in for an isolated HTTPS lab, false in production.
Updates 11 (#346) closes the artifact-origin question by measurement, with no
rejection: this list grants private / CGNAT exceptions, not an exclusive host
allowlist. The measured non-private artifact origin needs no exception. See [installer configuration](../node/install.md#authenticated-updater-reporting-f10-02-136-13103).

If sealing logs `result_url_missing`, the receipt remains **pending**, with its
original bytes and no ACK. Explicit `Engine.Flush` without a sink returns
`VALIDATION_FAILED`; local apply success is not central delivery. Repair the
reporting configuration, then run `fvpn-updater flush --config /etc/vpn-node/updater.json`
to transmit the identical pending receipt once. Verify the central ACK; do not
rebuild the receipt or rerun the update to manufacture a new result.
[Updater 18 evidence](follow-up-20.md#installer-7-and-updater-18--341--342).

After a short agent process restart on the same OS boot, a still-valid original
signed lease can retain serving without a new control response, intermediate
baseline or Apply. Adoption requires matching desired/applied generation,
the original clock anchor, a fresh serving heartbeat, eligible release,
fresh DNS/probe checks, full kernel/topology verification, healthy meter
ownership and clear identity/updater barriers. Operators can see retained then
adopted serving under the **same absolute deadline**. Ordinary stop checkpoints
the last usage delta and leaves its epoch open; updater withdrawal still
finalizes it. Failed qualification closes forwarding while keeping control
access; OS reboot or a lost anchor cannot adopt the old lease. Same-generation
repair queues the failed verifier report before repairing with the original
lease; recovery does not erase that observation. Retain agent/watchdog reason
logs and all baseline/heartbeat producer rows for isolation 10. This contract
does not identify ISO-F6-03's historical writer or establish zero pre-D loss.
[Agent 28 evidence and D-133](follow-up-20.md#agent-core-28--344-historical-writer-still-unattributed).
